message.content: {"caption":"A bordered text panel presents instructions for constructing and maintaining a conversation-memory workspace.","description":"The target is a single wide rectangular panel with a thin blue outline and a very pale gray background. A bold teal heading at the upper left reads “Prompt 1: Memory-construction instruction.” Beneath it, black text instructs the model to maintain a model-managed memory workspace for a long-running daily chat. It names the available tools: memory_read, rag_search, meta_log_read, memory_change, memory_review, and model-created declarative memory tools. The text says to keep memory useful, accurate, source-backed, and inexpensive for future conversation; use tools when useful; and check current or contradictory exact facts before relying on or saving dates, counts, versions, deadlines, current status, changed values, or user preferences. It favors atomic exact facts with source-turn references when such information occurs, and says to keep broad project profiles separate from exact-fact memory. It ends by warning not to invent facts unsupported by the chat or tool results. No arrows, icons, or other visual marks are present.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
